segments.en:
Then let's go over this project,
the Sea of Clouds Survey Plan,
one more time.
Lieutenant JG Rie, are you ready?

First, please take a look
at this footage.

rows.notes: Test scene; speaker headers are placeholders (segments 3-4 headed Kanji are Rie's answer).

segments.en:
I've checked and adjusted the
Impulse 7's Cloud System.

You take care of adjusting
the rest of the controls.

You could've just done
that much for me.
I still have work to do.

Besides, you're old enough to
put your own pants on by now, right?

I'm going to move the
camera zoom a bit.

See, it's moving, right? This
movement is specified by the
message text.

Then go handle the %6Depart%1
procedures first and head
up to the bridge.

And Akatsuki-- no, take
a message to the captain.

Tell them I'll head up to the
bridge after a few more checks.

...there are still some things about
its Cloud System bugging me...

rows.notes: Developer test scene (segments 7-8 test camera zoom). Speaker headers alternate wrongly; translated from content (father briefing Kanji). %6..%1 colour codes kept around 'Depart' (UI term). Seg 11 '[jp] [jp]' kept ambiguous (calls Akatsuki, then corrects to 'the captain'). Seg 12: 'Tell them' added since it is the message content; captain's gender unknown here.
Test text. [jp] is a jokey verbal tic; kept as 'nari'.

segments.en: This place sure has gone downhill.
